docs: correct asset/base64 description and quoting in the base64 example (#1795)

The asset/base64 docs reused the description of the Objective-C literal
transform ("Wraps the value in a double-quoted string and prepends an '@'")
and showed a quoted result, but the transform only returns the base64 string.
Since v4, formats also no longer wrap asset tokens in double quotes, yet the
assets-base64-embed example still showed quoted SCSS output, which led to
reports like #1508.

Describe what the transform does, show its unquoted output, update the
example's expected output with a note on how to add quotes, and fix its Sass
snippet to interpolate the variable, as Sass does not expand variables
inside quoted strings.

Closes
